gold.question: Under Directive (EU) 2019/771, may a consumer terminate the sales contract when the lack of conformity is only minor?
gold.reference_answer: No. The consumer is not entitled to terminate if the lack of conformity is only minor, and the seller bears the burden of proving that it is minor.
